mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a modular and a custom outdoor kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modular outdoor kitchens consist of pre-fabricated units that can be configured in various layouts, offering a quicker installation and often a lower cost. Custom outdoor kitchens are designed and built from scratch to fit specific spaces and aesthetic preferences, allowing for unique features and material choices. A practical tradeoff is between the flexibility and personalized aesthetic of a custom build versus the efficiency and potentially lower budget of a modular system. Custom options allow for integration with existing architecture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modular outdoor kitchens use pre-fabricated units for quicker, more affordable installation. Custom kitchens are built from scratch for specific spaces and aesthetics. The tradeoff is flexibility versus efficiency.
